need.purpose_or_required_outcome: Create a Markdown report from supplied structured content and preserve observable artifact provenance.

responsibilities: compose supplied title and sections into a report
expose the produced report as an attributed artifact

solution.short_rationale: The responsibility is fixed and already satisfied by an admitted Capability; an Agent or new Workflow would add no value.

evidence_requirements: artifact producer retains compose_report Capability identity and invocation identity
trace contains invocation start/completion and artifact creation
unknown Capability fails at the Adapter resolution boundary without changing Runtime semantics
not_required_now: Agent loop selected as product solution form

governance.stop_condition: Stop after existing Capability reuse and boundary attribution are deterministically proven.
